_comment2: CUSTOM2 (2026-09-08) — the ten axes of the morning brief and the day-close are keys HERE, in both stores, because one act has to move both surfaces (and, through brief_settings.wrap_group_section, the wrap's grouping). morning-briefing keeps its three original knobs beside them (leads_with is shared — same key, same meaning, widened choice set) and end-of-day keeps its seven; the new keys are added BESIDE, never in place of. brief_settings.AXES is the reader-facing home of the defaults, the questions, the one-sentence paths and the resets — this map is the write-time allow list only.
_comment: Settings-layer C4 — per-skill allowed top-level config keys (FRP1 skill_config). save_skill_config() rejects unknown keys LOUDLY at write for any skill listed here (the commitment shape-drift lesson applied to config); a skill absent from this map is permissive (back-compat — validation only tightens where a schema is declared). cleanup's weekly config lint (lint_skill_configs) flags live-config keys not in this map. Keys are the top-level config keys from each skill's DEFAULTS block; nested structure (e.g. going_quiet.enabled) is not enforced here. Grow this map as a skill's knobs change — in the SAME commit that changes the DEFAULTS (CONTRACT Rule 29).
